params.message:
A trend someone from the editorial team checked shows its reading again

The pipeline sends a checked trend's reading with checked_at. The site keeps
the prose only with it and shows the four parts as before 9 November, and the
card in the list carries a summary from the checked text. Anything unchecked
stays measured only.

- trend_cards.checked_at; TrendCard::checkedReading
- Projection keeps prose and summary only with a valid checked_at
- Trend page: Signal, Why it matters, The semiotic read, How to activate it

Portal: Op gentells.com staat bij een trend opnieuw de volledige tekst, zodra iemand van de redactie hem nakeek.
